gaps.sentence: Thousands of homes ___ (flood) when the river burst its banks.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + flooded. The cause (the river) is in the when-clause.

gaps.sentence: Did you have the brakes ___ (check) before the long drive?
gaps.hint: question form of have something done
gaps.explanation: Causative question: Did you have + the brakes + checked? A mechanic did the checking.

gaps.sentence: Your luggage ___ (weigh) at check-in, so allow extra time.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + weighed. The agent (staff) is obvious.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.

gaps.sentence: Hamlet ___ (perform) almost continuously since it was written.
gaps.explanation: 'Since + past clause' requires present perfect passive: has been + performed.

gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.

gaps.sentence: The parcels ___ (deliver) every morning before the shop opens.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive (am/is/are + past participle) for regular, repeated actions: are delivered.

gaps.sentence: The national anthem ___ (compose) by a little-known music teacher.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + composed; 'by a music teacher' names the agent.
